Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 22-Dec-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE MAKEUP EXAMINATIONS - DECEMBER 2025  
  Introduction to internet of things [NPT_4129]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                      Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                Discuss the IoT protocols that you recommend the most suitable connectivity solution for an              (5)  
  industrial monitoring system with high interference and long-range requirements.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  B)           Analyse the differences between CoAP and XMPP                                                            (5)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
2)                Discuss the Integration of Sensors and Actuators with Arduino with a case of your choice.                (5)  
  
  A)                                                          Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Suppose you are developing a health-monitoring Sensor-Cloud for remote patient care. What                (5)  
  sensors and actuators would you include? Apply your understanding to write the workflow in detail.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3)                A self-driving car uses multiple IoT-enabled cameras mounted at different angles. Describe the           (5)  
  data flow from sensors to the cloud and how it supports autonomous decision-making.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Analyse the concept of V2X communication to design a scenario where vehicles cooperate to                (5)  
  manage a highway merge automatically.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
4)                Analyse your understanding of connected vehicle systems to describe how sensor integration and           (5)  
  IoT connectivity improve driver assistance functions  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Apply the reliability and scalability requirements of IIoT to suggest suitable network architectures for (5)  
  continuous industrial operations.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5)                Analyze the concept of IoT to design a smart irrigation system that optimizes water usage in             (5)  
  agriculture.  
  
  Page #1

A)                                                            Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)                Apply your understanding of IoT architectures to compare how data collection, communication, and (5)  
  analytics differ across the three domains - Agriculture, Healthcare, and Activity Monitoring.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"
